cancel.heading: Cancel nangu opt out
cancel.policy: Ukucila nshiku 7 before start: full refund minus 5% admin fee. 1–7 days: 50% refund. Panshi ya maola 24: takuli refund (kuti watransfer). Refunds shilequeue, tashilipilwa nomba.
cancel.queued: Refund ya {amount} yaqueue. Mukalipilwa pa original mobile-money rail.
cancel.voidedNoRefund: Ticket yavoidwa. Takuli refund mu iyi window.
cancel.tooLate: Iyi ticket tacingacancelwa pa refund. Transfer instead.
cancel.noReschedule: Iyi event taikala rescheduled, takuli icakufuma.
